confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from one aggregated search that returned Numbeo-based figures (via Expatica, June 2026), plus Idealista and Citycost. They were converted at roughly 1.16 USD per EUR, which is my assumption. Restaurant meal and coffee anchors are the most reliable. Beer is based on a Numbeo 0.5L draught figure of about €3.13 and Idealista's 'from €2.50', so I used a smaller typical serving. No direct cocktail or restaurant wine-by-the-glass data was found. Those two are estimated from their usual relationship to beer in Spain (cocktail about 3x a caña, glass of wine about 1.2-1.3x). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Andalusian city pricing, not from live listings. July is hot low season in Córdoba, which may push prices down.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other mid-sized Andalusian tourist cities such as Seville, Granada and Málaga. Córdoba is reported as about a third cheaper than Madrid for restaurant items.
